summary: On the main deck, Morpheus is in tears as he takes hold of the EMP switch, apparently preparing to trigger it. Trinity, holding Neo's body, whispers in his ear and pleads with him to listen. She recounts that the Oracle told her she would fall in love and that the man she loved would be 'the one.' She insists Neo cannot be dead because she loves him, declaring it twice, then closes her eyes and kisses him, believing wholeheartedly he will sense her mouth and understand the truth of her words.
